doc: Vibrance + saturation on straight colour. Let G = Rec.709 luma gray, S = HSV saturation (max-min)/max of the colour. Colour = G + (c - G) * f with f = fv * (1 + saturation/100), fv = 1 + v (1 - S) for vibrance v = vibrance/100 >= 0 (low-saturation colours are boosted most, grey is unaffected, fully saturated colours not at all) and fv = 1 + v S for v < 0 (saturated colours are reduced most). `saturation` -100 gives luma grey, +100 doubles the distance from grey (linear in the luma / chroma plane, not in HSV). Result clamped to 0..1, alpha unchanged.
